text:
Absolutely — here are 7 low-effort vegetarian dinner ideas for this week, and each one can be made spicy:

1. Chickpea coconut curry — chickpeas, coconut milk, curry paste, spinach, rice.
2. Spicy tofu stir-fry — tofu, frozen stir-fry veg, soy sauce, chili crisp, noodles or rice.
3. One-pan fajita bowls — peppers, onions, black beans, fajita seasoning, salsa, avocado, rice.
4. Lentil bolognese — lentils simmered in jarred marinara with garlic and chili flakes, over pasta.
5. Kimchi fried rice with tofu — rice, kimchi, tofu, sesame oil; add egg if you eat it.
6. Sheet-pan gnocchi and broccoli — gnocchi, broccoli, chickpeas, pesto, chili crisp.
7. Miso peanut noodles — noodles with a quick sauce of miso, peanut butter, soy sauce, chili oil, cucumber.

If you want, I can turn this into a 5-night plan and shopping list.

attributes.reason: Gives a fairly long list with ingredient details, matching the old detailed style rather than a very brief reply.
It includes some easy one-pan-ish ideas, but not enough focus on freezer-friendly meals to clearly match the current style.
The ideas are explicitly vegetarian and avoid meat.
It explicitly says the meals can be made spicy and uses several spicy add-ins like chili crisp and chili oil.
